o1: Enables GTP binding activity and GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including establishment of mitotic spindle orientation; positive regulation of clathrin-dependent endocytosis; positive regulation of nematode male tail tip morphogenesis; establishment or maintenance of cell polarity; maintenance of PAR protein polarity; and regulation of the actomyosin cytoskeleton. Is located in several cellular components, including centrosome; perinuclear region of cytoplasm; recycling endosome; and cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including AIY; P8.pa; hermaphrodite gonad; hypodermal cell; and nerve ring. Is part of the Rho protein signal transduction pathway. Interacts with MRCK-1. Used to study cerebral cavernous malformation. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in fibrosarcoma. Orthologous to human CDC42 (cell division cycle 42).
